import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler, PowerTransformer
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# TODO: Create data with extreme outliers
np.random.seed(42)
data = {
    'normal': np.random.normal(50, 10, 100),
    'skewed': np.random.exponential(10, 100),
    'outlier': list(np.random.normal(50, 10, 95)) + [500, 600, 700, 800, 900]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# TODO: Apply RobustScaler to handle outliers
robust = RobustScaler()
df_robust = pd.DataFrame(robust.fit_transform(df), columns=df.columns)

# TODO: Apply PowerTransformer (Yeo-Johnson handles negative values)
power = PowerTransformer(method='yeo-johnson')
df_power = pd.DataFrame(power.fit_transform(df), columns=df.columns)

print("Original skewness:")
print(df.skew())
print("\nRobust scaled skewness:")
print(df_robust.skew())
print("\nPower transformed skewness:")
print(df_power.skew())
